simplex-noise
=============

Package:  simplex-noise (jwagner)
Version:  4.0.3
License:  MIT (see ./LICENSE)
Author:   Jonas Wagner <https://github.com/jwagner/simplex-noise.js>
Source:   https://unpkg.com/simplex-noise@4.0.3/dist/esm/simplex-noise.js
Vendored: 2026-07-12

WHY VENDORED
------------
Zero-dependency ESM. Strict CSP / offline runtime — NO CDN at runtime. This file
is NOT referenced by index.html; it is lazy-imported ONLY by the star-cruise
modules (app/starcruise/planet.js) which are themselves loaded behind the mode's
dynamic import().

DETERMINISM
-----------
v4 deliberately REMOVED its built-in PRNG: createNoise2D/3D/4D(random) take a
0..1 random function. We ALWAYS pass OUR seeded mulberry32 — e.g.
  createNoise3D(mulberry32(seed))
so noise is byte-deterministic against the app's seed (no Date.now / Math.random).

EXPORTS
-------
  createNoise2D(random = Math.random) -> (x, y)      -> [-1, 1]
  createNoise3D(random = Math.random) -> (x, y, z)   -> [-1, 1]
  createNoise4D(random = Math.random) -> (x, y, z, w)-> [-1, 1]
  buildPermutationTable(random)  (internal/testing only)

UNMODIFIED — this is the upstream dist/esm build byte-for-byte.
